# OneGlanse

> Free, open-source AI visibility tracking for marketing teams.

OneGlanse collects rendered answers and available citations from the ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and Google AI Overview interfaces with browser automation. Provider collection does not use model APIs. A separately configured model endpoint analyzes captured responses afterward.

Analysis fields such as visibility, rank, sentiment, and recommendation are model-backed interpretations of captured samples. Results can vary by prompt, account, location, and time.
